propositions: Closing a bug ticket triggers post-write _find_fixing_commit traversal that re-resolves the bug_id per commit against 2137 commits and 3823 ticket directories, causing ~9 minutes of unmetered alias scanning and emitting 'Ambiguous prefix' errors for bare 4-hex commit subjects.

The enrichment drain was incorrectly attributed as the source; the actual defect is in metrics/blame.py _resolves_to and _commit_ticket which invoke resolve_ticket_id with no quiet flag, no cache, and no shape filter, allowing unrelated 4-hex fragments from commit subjects to fall through to _scan_alias.

Four fixes required: pass quiet=True at all scanner call sites in blame.py, hoist loop-invariant bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop, memoize ref-to-resolution for the derivation duration, and short-circuit on hex-quad shape before touching the store since such refs can only match if the target id starts with them.

Documentation guidance must stop advertising bare 4-digit (single-quad) hex references as a supported form; only alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full canonical id, and Jira ids should be recommended, while compatibility resolution remains unchanged.

The hex-quad short-circuit guards against silently drifting by asserting that resolve_ticket_id with that ref shape skips the alias scan, making the optimization semantics-preserving and provably sound across 1-, 2-, and 4-quad forms.

Post-fix verification shows derive_caused_by now returns in 0.06s with no ambiguous prefix output versus pre-fix ~9 minutes of alias scanning, with regression tests confirming no id form gained or lost resolution capability.
